name: People’s Republic of China proclaimed
short_desc: Mao Zedong proclaims the People’s Republic of China after Communist victories in the civil war.
date_note: Proclaimed in Beijing on 1 October 1949. Civil-war fighting did not all end that day, and the Republic of China continued to exist.
notes: Added after a catalog gap review on 24 October 2026. A central change in twentieth-century world politics missing between the catalog’s imperial dynasties and Mao-era campaigns. Evidence and date rationale: Proclaimed in Beijing on 1 October 1949. This is the establishment milestone, not a claim that all civil-war fighting ended that day or that the Republic of China ceased to exist. Primary evidence: https://history.state.gov/milestones/1945-1952/chinese-rev. Cached Wikipedia introduction and lead image provide separately attributed background. Remains review, not comprehensive factual approval.
